use_case: Ambient clinical documentation (AI scribe): records the visit and drafts the note for provider review
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (generative speech-to-text and large language model; model hosting carved out)
source_evidence: EV-035 (40 provider seats from 2026-02); EV-036 (vendor standard BAA); EV-050 (AI tool discovery); EV-054 (consent practice)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if diagnosis or order suggestions are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Provider reviews, edits, and signs every note; attestation checkbox at signing
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (vendor is a BA; BAA amendment pending); Fla. Stat. 934.03 all-party consent; 45 CFR 92.210 only if clinical suggestion features are enabled; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production (40 providers since 2026-02); expansion paused until conditions are met

use_case: EHR clinical decision support alerts (212 active rules: screening, drug interaction, dosing, and risk reminders)
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor rules engine (rule-based; some vendor-supplied predictive scores)
data_categories: Age; sex; problem list; medications; labs; 1 legacy rule used race (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Providers accept, modify, or dismiss each alert; no automatic orders
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tool; input variables include age and sex, and 1 rule used race); HIPAA
status: In production; 92.210(b) review completed 2026-09-04; mitigation of 1 rule due 2026-10-31

use_case: Imaging triage: flags suspected intracranial hemorrhage on head CT and pulmonary embolism on chest CT angiography and moves them up the reading worklist
vendor_or_model: PACS-integrated FDA-cleared computer-aided triage software (vendor-managed in the company's cloud account)
source_evidence: EV-050 (triage module in PACS since 2025); EV-052 (model version log); EV-037 (no review record)
data_categories: CT images and DICOM metadata including age and sex fields (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Radiologist reads every study, flagged or not; the tool never removes a study from the worklist or sends results to patients
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (supports clinical decision-making; intended use limited to adults, so age is an input condition); FDA clearance and labeling (manufacturer duties); 21 CFR 803.30 user facility reporting (imaging center); HIPAA
status: In production since 2025; monitoring conditions added

use_case: Prior-authorization automation: extracts clinical information from notes, completes payer forms, and submits requests; 70% submitted without human review
vendor_or_model: Prior-authorization automation vendor (robotic process automation with a large language model)
source_evidence: EV-035 (subscription from 2025-11); EV-036 (BAA on file); EV-054 (about 70% submitted without review)
data_categories: Clinical notes; diagnoses; procedure codes; coverage data (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Today: staff review only exceptions the tool flags. Required: staff approval before submission for ASC and imaging cases, and a monthly accuracy sample
applicable_laws: HIPAA (vendor is a BA; BAA on file); False Claims Act exposure for inaccurate submissions (counsel to advise); 42 CFR 422.101(c)(1)(i) applies to Medicare Advantage organizations' determinations, not to the company's submissions
status: In production since 2025-11; human approval step due 2026-12-31

use_case: Website chatbot: answers scheduling and general questions and collects appointment requests
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (large language model with a scripted knowledge base)
source_evidence: EV-035 (subscription from 2026-04); EV-036 (no BAA); EV-050 (AI tool discovery)
data_categories: Names; dates of birth; phone numbers; reason for visit (free text); PHI once linked to the company's patients
consequential_decision_category: None (information and scheduling); escalates to Health care if it gives clinical advice
human_in_the_loop: Scheduling requests go to the call center for confirmation; clinical questions must hand off to the nurse line
applicable_laws: HIPAA (vendor receives PHI for the company, so a BAA is required; none on file); FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy and privacy representations); disclosure of AI interaction (company rule)
status: In production since 2026-04; free-text symptom field to be disabled and BAA executed by 2026-11-30, or the chatbot is switched off
